en.headline: HKU completes Asia's first histotripsy treatments for kidney cancer
en.dek: Two patients with early-stage tumours were treated without incision using focused ultrasound and discharged the next day without complications.
body: The University of Hong Kong's Faculty of Medicine said it had completed Asia's first two cases of histotripsy treatment for primary kidney cancer.

A research team led by the Department of Surgery treated a 70-year-old man and a 71-year-old woman, each with tumours of about two centimetres, in under an hour. Both patients were discharged the following day with no complications observed.

Histotripsy uses focused ultrasound guided by real-time imaging to generate microbubble clouds that break down tumour tissue from outside the body, preserving the kidney. The team said the clinical study would continue recruiting suitable early-stage patients, with treatment provided free of charge for a limited number of places.

zh.headline: 港大完成亞洲首兩宗組織碎化技術治療腎癌
zh.dek: 兩名早期腫瘤病人接受無創聚焦超聲波治療，翌日出院，未見併發症。
body: 香港大學醫學院表示，已完成亞洲首兩宗以組織碎化技術（Histotripsy）治療原發性腎癌的病例。
由外科學系領導的研究團隊為一名70歲男士及一名71歲女士進行治療，兩人腫瘤約2厘米，手術在一小時內完成。兩名病人均於翌日出院，未觀察到併發症。
組織碎化技術透過即時超聲波影像引導，從體外發射聚焦超聲波，在腫瘤內產生微氣泡雲以液化腫瘤組織，可保留腎臟。團隊指臨床研究將繼續招募合適的早期腎癌病人，部分名額治療費用全免。
